====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

INTRODUCTION

Understanding Inequalities. Get clear on inequalities before moving on. How would you explain inequalities to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: Form simple inequalities in one unknown involving real-life situations,. Clue from the topic: Form simple inequalities in one. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• An algebraic expression uses numbers and letters (variables) joined by operations.
• Like terms have the same variable part — combine them; unlike terms stay separate.
• To solve an equation, undo operations carefully on both sides.
• Check by substituting your answer back into the original equation.
• Example: if x = 8, then 2x + 7 = 23.

MAIN NOTES
----
• An algebraic expression uses numbers and letters (variables) joined by operations.
• Like terms have the same variable part — combine them; unlike terms stay separate.
• To solve an equation, undo operations carefully on both sides.
• Check by substituting your answer back into the original equation.
• Example: if x = 8, then 2x + 3 = 19.

WORKED EXAMPLE

A trader sells 10 items at Ksh 20 each. Find the total.

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Total = number × amount each
2. Substitute values: Total = 10 × 20
3. Total = 200
Final Answer: Ksh 200
